summary: SMX (Security Matters) Public Ltd Co filed a Form 6-K announcing a reverse stock split, effective June 1, 2026, with a split ratio of 2.285:1, reducing outstanding shares from ~1.5 million to ~650,000. No shareholder approval was needed as authority was granted in 2025. The par value adjusts accordingly; fractional shares will be sold and proceeds distributed. The move aims to meet Nasdaq listing requirements. No advisor or board recommendation is mentioned. The filing is a routine corporate action and does not constitute a special situation. What to watch: potential impact on trading liquidity and compliance.
